video:video.video:title: An engineering team made of AI agents
video:video.video:description: One real ticket through a loop of AI agents (domain expert, product manager, developer, reviewer) and the change that stops at a person; then October in numbers: over 300 pull requests merged and, in the last week, 4 minutes from merge to live with a 1 % change failure rate.

video:video.video:title: Two AI mistakes in one day
video:video.video:description: On 30 October 2026 an AI agent made two mistakes on optionsBot: fake but realistic keys in a test file, and a rebuild on the wrong base that reverted merged work. A secret scan and the Reviewer agent stopped both before they reached main.

video:video.video:title: Delivery, measured
video:video.video:description: The four DORA metrics for a team of AI agents in the week of 26 October 2026, one change from issue to live in 50 minutes, and why the test and stable environments move at different speeds.

video:video.video:title: What an AI reviewer catches
video:video.video:description: 158 AI code reviews on optionsBot: 19 blocked a merge. Three real bugs it caught, and what an AI reviewer still can't decide.

video:video.video:title: Agile with AI agents
video:video.video:description: How a team of AI agents runs Agile on a real GitHub Projects board: epics from an approved PRD, triage, a Dev agent pull request and a Reviewer agent block. For engineering managers and Agile leaders.

video:video.video:title: DevOps for a team of AI agents
video:video.video:description: A scheduler wakes the AI agents every 6 minutes; one ticket goes from epic to Done in 45 minutes; CI runs on GitHub Actions on every push; stable takes a release only after a 3-day soak or an escalation with its reason on record.

video:video.video:title: The product the agents built
video:video.video:description: A tour of the optionsBot monitor, built by a team of AI agents: the overview, positions in a short strangle, a one-legged position in a negative gamma regime, the worst case, income with losses shown, the activity journal and an AI assistant with sourced answers.
